kultivator.technique.space_blade.desc: Pushes a thin crack in space forward 20→48 blocks, cutting through every monster on the line for 1.5×P armour-piercing damage.
kultivator.technique.space_blade.source: Source: Martial Peak ch. 1139 · Space Blade, Yang Kai's self-created space art: tiny space cracks pushed forward like a wind blade
kultivator.technique.space_blade.lore: The air does not part. It tears.
kultivator.technique.immortal_binding_ro: Stage 1: the rope leaps to your target within 20→40 blocks and on to 2→6 more within 4 blocks: 0.5×P and rooted for 80 ticks (bosses 30). Stage 2 (within 3 s): yank the bound monsters 6 blocks toward you.
Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 53–54 · 捆仙绳 Immortal-Binding Rope of Ju Liusun, stolen by Tu Xingsun
A golden thread that knows the shape of every immortal it has ever held.
kultivator.technique.qiankun_ring.desc: Throws a golden ring at your target within 24 blocks; it bounces 4→12 times between monsters up to 8 blocks apart for 1.8×P each (×0.85 per bounce) with knockback, then returns to you.
kultivator.technique.qiankun_ring.source: Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 12 · Nezha's golden 乾坤圈 Qiankun Ring, which kills the Dragon King's yaksha and third son
kultivator.technique.qiankun_ring.lore: Thrown by a child, it once silenced a dragon.
kultivator.technique.gravitational_space: A domain of crushing gravity, radius 10→24, follows you for 240→360 ticks: every second 0.3×P, Slowness IV, no jumping or flying, double fall damage and a slam toward the ground.
Source: Coiling Dragon (Books 15–16) · Gravitational Space, a high profound mystery of the Laws of the Earth that Linley struggles to fuse
Here even a feather falls like a mountain.
kultivator.technique.moon_blade.desc: Three thin crescents of torn space fan out (−15°, 0°, +15°) and fly 32→64 blocks through walls: 2×P armour-piercing damage, at most two crescents per monster.
kultivator.technique.moon_blade.source: Source: Martial Peak · the Moon Blade, Yang Kai's improved Space Blade
kultivator.technique.moon_blade.lore: Three new moons, each one a cut in the world.
kultivator.technique.purple_gold_gourd.d: The gourd calls your target's name (24 blocks, no line of sight needed). One second later it swallows it whole if its max health is below 10×P; tougher monsters take 4×P, bosses 3×P and Slowness IV for 80 ticks.
kultivator.technique.purple_gold_gourd.s: Source: Journey to the West ch. 32–35 · 紫金红葫芦, the Golden and Silver Horn Kings' red gourd, sucks in whoever answers when it calls their name; Wukong later traps Silver Horn in it
kultivator.technique.purple_gold_gourd.l: Do not answer when a gourd calls your name.
kultivator.technique.heaven_turning_seal: A giant seal falls from 30 blocks up onto the aimed spot (within 40) after 1 s: 3.5×P and rooted for 40 ticks (bosses 10) in radius 7→16, then a shock wave 4 blocks wider deals 1×P and knocks monsters back.
Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 46 · Guang Chengzi's 番天印 Heaven-Turning Seal smashes 19 mirrors, then strikes Jin Guang Shengmu's crown and kills her
It turns heaven over, and whatever stood beneath is simply gone.
kultivator.technique.spatial_ancestral_s: Folds a field of radius 16→28 at the aimed spot for 10 s: up to 32 non-boss monsters inside are pulled through space to its centre, and everything inside takes 0.5×P armour-piercing damage every second. Cast again up to 7 times (1 s apart) to blink freely to any spot inside the field.
Source: Martial Universe ch. 1209 · the Spatial Ancestral Symbol, one of the eight Ancestral Symbols, held by Zhou Tong
Space folds like paper, and every corner of it is one step away.
The fold has closed: there is no space left to step through.
No safe spot inside the fold there.
kultivator.technique.yellow_brow_bag: Yellow Brows' Seed Bag and Golden Cymbals
kultivator.technique.yellow_brow_bag.des: A cloth bag opens at the aimed spot: for 3 s it sucks in up to 32 non-boss monsters within 20→32 blocks; then it holds them suspended for 100 ticks with qi damage of 0.5×P per second for 5 s (bosses are pinned under golden cymbals). After 8 s it spits them out for 3×P and knockback.
kultivator.technique.yellow_brow_bag.sou: Source: Journey to the West ch. 65–66 · the Yellow-Browed King, Maitreya's page boy, traps Wukong under stolen golden cymbals and swallows the heavenly helpers in his cloth bag until Maitreya subdues him
kultivator.technique.yellow_brow_bag.lor: The bag was made for seeds. It holds armies just as well.
kultivator.technique.heavenly_restrictio: Seals a walled cube (half-side 10→24) at the aimed spot for 8 s: every second 0.6×P, frozen in place and Weakness III; the damage grows 15% per layer (up to 8). When it ends, the cube collapses for 6×P on everything inside.
Source: Inspired by Wang Lin's restrictions (禁制) and his Restriction Flag (Renegade Immortal ch. 207, 233, 291); the layered cube and its name are game design
One restriction closes, then another, until there is nowhere left to stand.
kultivator.technique.void_mirror.desc: Stage 1: a void mirror stands before you for 10 s: half damage from the front, projectiles from the front are swallowed and answered with a strike on the shooter, and frontal blows are stored. Stage 2, or when the 10 s end: the mirror fires a 64-block void beam through everything for 10×P plus the stored blows.
kultivator.technique.void_mirror.source: Source: Shrouded the Heavens · 虚空镜 Void Mirror, the Void Great Emperor's imperial weapon, kept by the Ji family
kultivator.technique.void_mirror.lore: Whatever it reflects, it returns as nothing.
Time stops in a domain of radius 24→32 around you for 8 s: monsters inside freeze (bosses are rooted 40 ticks and slowed), and every hit you land on a stopped monster is banked. Your cooldowns run twice as fast. When time resumes, every bank is released ×1.5 and everything inside takes 10×P.
Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey · 时间灵域 Time Spirit Domain, gained at the Golden Immortal stage; Han Li later becomes the Time Dao Ancestor
Tick. The world holds its breath. Tock. It all arrives at once.
Opens a black hole at the aimed spot (within 48) for 6 s: everything within 32→40 is dragged toward the core and takes 0.5×P every half second (×5 within 3 blocks of the core). At the collapse the core deals 18×P within 16 and 4×P to everything in the field.
Source: Stellar Transformations · Black Hole, the stage after Dark Star; these post-Star stages were self-evolved and are not recorded in the original art
Past the darkest star, even light forgets how to leave.
